startup.note: first_frame_presented_ms is the first requestVideoFrameCallback (video only); loadeddata_ms is the element having the first frame/sample; playing_ms is the first "playing" event

playback.note: media_played_s integrates currentTime advances that are compatible with playback (50 ms steps); jumps (seeks, gap skips) are in media_jumped_s

frames.note: total/dropped/corrupted from getVideoPlaybackQuality(); presented from requestVideoFrameCallback metadata.presentedFrames

stalls.total_note: union of playhead stalls and element waiting->playing stalls after the first "playing"

latency.note: hls_latency_s is hls.latency (distance from the playlist live edge, per hls.js); program_date_time_latency_ms is Date.now() minus hls.playingDate and needs the reader clock to match the packager clock
